correctness.rationale: The digitwise carry identity gives D=w-K exactly; transition polynomials enumerate each binary input bit with correct probabilities. P has degree <=w, R<=w+2, and coefficient r_(w+2)=1/8 by forced carries through two zero separators. The exact geometric tail gives c=9/8-R(2)/2^(w+1). An explicit rational 2x2 matrix identity produces the multiaffine closed form, which the standalone standard-library checker verifies universally by eight-node interpolation and also by independent direct residue enumeration for all 27 triples a,b,c<=3. The derivatives of the numerator in A=4^-a,B=4^-b,C=4^-c are >0 on (0,1/4]^3, yielding strict monotonicity and sharp infimum. All length boundaries a,b,c>=1 are included; there is no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact three-block bound on the family with smallest possible zero separators is a natural infinite-parameter slice of Sobolewski–Spiegelhofer Conjecture 13, whose N=3 limit is already known but whose finite-word sharpness is not established there. Strict monotonicity of each block length is structural and especially relevant because global monotonicity fails in their larger-pattern examples. The multiaffine formula provides all exact finite densities and quantitative convergence; introducing a third block breaks the sharp known two-block 5/9 barrier. It is not an arbitrary fixed finite census or a merely cosmetic renaming.
